timestamp_rules: Preserve provider timestamp separately from local receive timestamp
Mark observations stale using instrument-specific configured thresholds; never silently forward-fill

rules: bid and ask must be positive finite decimals
ask must be greater than or equal to bid
spread is derived, never substituted for a provider value
price_basis must identify broker_executable, venue_quote, indicative_spot or reference_rate
OHLC values must be positive finite decimals
high must be at least max(open,close,low)
low must be at most min(open,close,high)
volume must be non-negative when supplied
bar close cannot precede bar open
incomplete bars must be explicitly flagged

prohibited_inference: A reference FX rate is not an executable quote.
A bullion spot quote is not automatically XAUUSD CFD pricing.
An index cash reference or ETF is not interchangeable with a CFD or futures contract.
A synthetic fixture cannot satisfy live-source readiness.
Different venues must not be spliced into one continuous series without an explicit transformation and provenance.
